findings.evidence: Multipole.lean:88-93 restates the body verbatim; `multipoleS_fin_two` (line 132) is proved by `simp [quadrupoleS_def, multipoleS_def, mul_assoc]`, i.e. by unfolding — the same route any `n = 3` consumer must take. No `List`/`Fin` lemma about `multipoleS` exists: grep for `List.ofFn|Fin.cons` in `EpsilonEridani/` hits only this file's definition.
findings.fix: Add `multipoleS_zero` (= 1 for `NeZero Nc`), a `Fin.cons` recursion lemma `multipoleS_succ`, and general cyclic invariance; these are what let a consumer reach the six-point correlator without unfolding.
findings.issue: `multipoleS` has no lemma relating it at `n+1` to `n` and no general cyclicity, so the only way to use it beyond `n ≤ 2` is `multipoleS_def`, which is the raw `List.ofFn (fun i => U (x i) * star (U (y i))) |>.prod` body. Layer 5.3 consumes exactly this structure ("the `n`-th equation involves the `(n+1)`-st correlator").

findings.evidence: `quadrupoleS_gaugeTransform` (line 192), `quadrupoleS_reverse` (line 179), `quadrupoleS_cycle` (line 142) and the four `quadrupoleS_self_*` (lines 149, 156, 163, 171) have no `multipoleS` counterpart; the docstring at lines 42-46 advertises these as properties of the correlator family.
findings.fix: State `multipoleS_gaugeTransform` (Ω₋ agreeing at each `(x i, y i)`, Ω₊ at each `(y i, x (i+1))` cyclically) and the general adjacent-coincidence collapse, deriving `quadrupoleS_gaugeTransform`/`quadrupoleS_self_*` from them rather than proving them independently.
findings.issue: Gauge invariance, reversal and the coincidence collapse are proved only for the quadrupole, though they hold for every `2n`-point correlator and the file already develops all three on the n=2 side. The general correlator is therefore publicly exposed with strictly less API than its own n=2 instance.

findings.evidence: Its proof is `rw [trace_conjTranspose, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_re]`; `Matrix.trace_conjTranspose` is `@[simp]` (upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Trace.lean:74-75) and `RCLike.conj_re` is `@[simp, rclike_simps]` (upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/RCLike/Basic.lean:302-303). The pre-PR `dipoleS_comm` closed the same step inline with those lemmas.
findings.fix: Drop the lemma (and its "Main results" entry at line 27) and keep the two call sites as the `simp only` they were, e.g. `simp only [dipoleS_def, h, trace_conjTranspose, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re]`.
findings.issue: `Matrix.re_trace_conjTranspose` adds a public declaration in the upstream `Matrix` namespace that is a one-step consequence of two upstream `@[simp]` lemmas, and it is itself not `@[simp]`, so consumers must name it where `simp` already closes the goal.

findings.evidence: Docstring lines 55-61 list only `multipoleS_fin_one`, `abs_multipoleS_le_one`, `multipoleS_fin_two`, `quadrupoleS_def`, the four coincidence limits and `quadrupoleS_gaugeTransform`; `abs_quadrupoleS_le_one` is declared at line 137 and the roadmap README.md:414-415 names `|Q| ≤ 1` as a target.
findings.fix: Add `SmallX.abs_quadrupoleS_le_one` and the three symmetry/transparency lemmas to the Main results list so the docstring matches the declarations the file actually exports.
findings.issue: The module's "Main results" list omits `abs_quadrupoleS_le_one`, the roadmap's explicitly named §0.6 target `|Q| ≤ 1`, as well as `multipoleS_self`, `quadrupoleS_cycle` and `quadrupoleS_reverse`.

summary: The general correlator `multipoleS` is exposed with no characteristic API beyond its `_def` restatement and the n=1,2 specialisations, so any consumer at n ≥ 3 must unfold the `List.ofFn … .prod` body by hand; and `Matrix.re_trace_conjTranspose` adds public surface that upstream `@[simp]` lemmas already close.
